{{External|rs=Area Tasks achievements|dw}}
{{redirect|Achievements|combat achievements|Combat Achievements|Steam profile achievements|Steam Achievements}}
[[File:Achievement Diaries.png|left|130px]]
[[File:Achievement Diary tab.png|frame|The Achievement Diary interface.]]
The '''Achievement Diaries''' are sets of challenges exclusive to [[members]] that are completed for various rewards and benefits. These diaries consist of 492 tasks across 12 regions in [[Gielinor]], intended to test the player's skills and knowledge about ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''.

The tasks of each diary are split into four tiers based on their perceived difficulty: easy, medium, hard, and elite. Easy tasks may simply involve browsing a [[shop]] or praying at an [[altar]], whereas the most difficult tasks involve surviving the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]] and having completed all [[quest]]s. The skill requirements for all tasks are also based on these tiers, with levels reaching up to 40 for easy tasks, 65 for medium tasks, 75 for hard tasks, and in the 90s for elite tasks ([[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] may require even higher levels).

Whenever the player has completed any diary tier, they may claim various rewards from that diary's taskmaster. Tasks can be completed from different tiers in any order, but claiming the rewards for a tier requires all preceding tiers of that diary to be completed as well. Rewards for each tier always include an [[antique lamp]] and an equippable item, in addition to various benefits such as increased [[experience]] rates and access to new areas.

Players who have completed all the achievement diaries can purchase an [[achievement diary cape]] from [[Twiggy O'Korn]] in [[Draynor Village]] for 99,000 [[coins]]. Owning this cape grants the player the option add a cyan trim to their [[quest point cape]], and serves as one of the requirements to add a black trim to the [[music cape]].

==Changes==
For more changes to individual diaries, see the pages for each separate diary.

{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 10 July 2024
|update = While Guthix Sleeps
|change = A couple of diary tasks have been refined:
* Pickpocketing Movario has been replaced with grappling a pylon on the Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course.
* Getting a slayer task from Duradel has been replaced with the Slayer Master in Shilo Village.
* Getting a slayer task from Mazchna has been replaced with the Slayer Master in Canifis.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 14 April 2021
|update = Below Ice Mountain
|change = All diary tasks to craft runes were changed to clarify they only can be completed with essence.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 10 January 2019
|update = The Kebos Lowlands
|change = Added the Kourend & Kebos  Diary.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 28 July 2016
|update = Dragon Spear Changes & Beta 3
|change =
* You can now complete tasks in achievement diaries without having first started the diary.
* The Achievement Diaries list is now ordered alphabetically.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 22 October 2015
|update = Abyssal Bludgeon Buff
|poll = 
|change = 
* Some multi-stage achievement diary tasks have been restructured to resolve issues where their progress got confused.
* Corrected punctuation and grammar in some achievement diary tasks.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 16 July 2015
|update = Duel Arena Rework
|change = Fixed misspelling of "receive" in Ardougne, Karamja, Morytania and Wilderness Diaries.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 18 June 2015
|update = Multiple Clues & Midsummer
|change = Degraded barrows equipment, mage arena capes and achievement diary reward items are now also protected on death, outside of PvP, in line with other untradeable items.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 14 May 2015
|update = System Update & Poll 33
|change = Prevented some diary task messages from appearing if you haven't started the related diary.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 7 May 2015
|update = Slayer Partners & Teleports
|change = The achievement diary teleports now have some fancy new [[graphical updates]]. The teleports to the Ardougne monastery, Ardougne farming patch, Falador cabbage patch, slime pit and Nardah all received a makeover.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 30 April 2015
|update = Mutagens, Mo & Much More
|change = Added some area checks for a couple of diary tasks.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 24 March 2016
|update = White & Black Graceful
|poll = Old School Content Poll 40: Vanilla LootShare & QoL
|change =
*It is now also possible to get multiple copies of achievement diary equipment by talking to relevant diary masters or by talking to Perdu, found upstairs in the Edgeville general store. Perdu will charge a small fee.
*The "Destroy" option on all achievement diary equipment was replaced with a "Drop" option.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 19 March 2015
|update = Boss Pets, Sets, Chat & More
|change = 
*Fixed a number of zone checks and typos relating to achievement diaries.
*Task increment messages should no longer appear on F2P Worlds.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 5 March 2015
|update = Achievement Diaries
|change = Added ten new achievement diaries and the elite tier for the Karamja Diary.
}}
{{Subject changes footer}}
